scope: Public sources used in historical research. Raw sources and environments are outside the Git checkout. Two exact sensor-only 1600-row prefixes are optional release assets.
source_state: All sources listed here have been disclosed during development; none is a new held-out validation source for a future revision.

sources.title: GECCO 2017 water-quality challenge data
sources.meaning: External drinking-water benchmark; not MAWRID field measurements. Challenge year is not the measurement year. EVENT is not a five-fault label.

sources.title: Data for: The Value of Human Data Annotation for Machine Learning based Anomaly Detection in Environmental Systems
sources.publisher: Eawag: Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology
sources.meaning: WaterHub/NEST pH time series in a multi-domain public research collection. Adaptation keeps gaps and unknown labels. Six monthly periods are disclosed development evidence, not independent MAWRID field validation. Archive software licensing is separate; no archive software is redistributed in the optional replay assets.

license_note: Dataset licenses apply to their data, not to unrelated code or the entire MAWRID repository. Retain attribution and third-party notices. This inventory is not a water-safety or deployment certificate.
